features: SCREEN SIZE: Experience vibrant clarity with a 21.5-inch(54.6cm) screen LED monitor with a 16:9 aspect ratio that delivers wide, crisp views for work, study, and daily use while consuming just 26W.
RESOLUTION- Its FHD (1920x1080) resolution displays sharper text, clearer visuals, and an overall better viewing experience.
BRIGHTNESS- Seamlessly adjust the screen brightness up to 250nits (Max.), making it comfortable to use in different lighting conditions.
